Yes. For the Matelas Hybride I recommended, there is a 10-year full warranty from the delivery date. It applies to the original purchaser when bought directly from Tediber.

It covers visible sagging over 2.5 cm, manufacturing defects causing cracks or significant deformation, defects in the cover, and persistent rubbing noises between the springs and foam. If the defect is confirmed, Tediber repairs or replaces the product or affected part, with free delivery. The warranty itself does not provide a refund, and it is separate from the 100-night home trial.

If you change your mind, you can return the mattress during the 100-night home trial or within the 14-day legal withdrawal period.

We do not offer exchanges for a different model or size. You can return the mattress for a refund, then place a new order for the product you prefer.

To request a refund:

Create your return request here: https://www.tediber.com/a/return
Enter your 6-digit order number.
Add photos of the product if it has been unpacked. If your order included free products, they must also be returned for the refund to be approved.

For a mattress, you do not need to put it back in its original box and you will not receive a return label. The return page will provide a link to arrange collection with the carrier. The mattress should be dismantled as needed so it can pass through doors and stairways.
